_note: The after-fight pick's upgrades (docs/plans/upgrade-pools.md; built in phase 5c step 7, docs/plans/rebuild-phase5c-combos.md, section 15). Three layers: a hero's own cards ("hero"), always offered; a path's taste cards ("path" with "taste": true), offered while vowed to it until the hero transforms, and carried on after with their "transformed_mod" (Decision 35); and a path's cards ("path"), offered once transformed. Each is a kit modifier (KitMod) on the hero's slots; a stacking card ("stacks") locks in a share of the hero's stat when taken and can be taken again; a growing card ("grows") grows all run. The pick never offers a card that changes nothing on the hero's kit now (Decision 37). Numbers are placeholders.
